notes: Authorial page 24; the lighter foliation at the lower left is 48, and H’s archive page is therefore 48 for scan 49. The sheet gives a conjectural fixed-subgroup consequence for a rational point, asks about its relationship to the preceding body of conjectures, and then discusses model-compatible homomorphisms and inverse limits. These are the author’s claims and have not been mathematically checked in this reading. The opening appeal to a conjectural consequence is cancelled, with its inherited lexical doubt retained. The long vertical stroke is a margin rule, not a diagram or an enclosure inferred beyond what is drawn. Three rounded extension capitals are transcribed as script E; these alphabet-only rows are non-consequential. Both geometric-group letters retain C’s capital Pi as primary, with lowercase pi as an explicit graphical alternative. This is a new local doubt, not a case correction against C; the variable names are not inferred from their mathematical role. The relèvement connector retains a dash/arrow doubt. The visible opening quote pair by cons. is secure, while its scope relative to the insertion remains doubtful. The first fondamentale has a comma; modèles does not. The oblique note has no extra même. Its article and noun are tentatively singular, while risquent remains the first doubtful verb reading; no agreement is supplied. Its compressed équivalence reading is left uncertain, without inventing a specific abbreviated ending. The last word limite has one hooked underline and no detached final period. In the lower paragraph the complètes/complets wording is unresolved, but its two long curves are insertion leaders to the gap after prenant, not separate parentheses. The cancelled de dim belongs before qui sont; schémas is separately cancelled and replaced above by modèles élém. The final addition is literally des imm ouvertes, without a dot after imm, and attaches before affines. No final punctuation is supplied after affines. The final line reaches the lower paper edge after affines without visible terminal punctuation. Line count records 21 main baseline lines, six marginal lines, four raised writing runs, and two number entries. All original/half reading was completed before the cropped review; the initially truncated crop batch was not counted as visual inspection.
